finding_key: .github/workflows/agent-review-panel.yml::`allowed_bots` may not be a supported input at the pinned claude-code-action commit, in which case it is silently ignored and the fix job still fails
evidence: The claim is a hedged hypothesis ("may not be a supported input"), not an observed defect: it depends entirely on anthropics/claude-code-action's action.yml at pin af0559ee (agent-review-panel.yml:404, agent-iterate-ci.yml:151), which is listed as absent-at-round and which I have no checkout to inspect. The mechanism it describes is accurate — undeclared inputs only produce a warning — but that only matters if the input is genuinely missing at that SHA. Evidence in the diff itself cuts against the claim: the author's comment at agent-iterate-ci.yml:155-157 cites action-specific behaviour ("'*', which the action warns is unsafe on public repos"), which matches the documented v1 `allowed_bots` input, suggesting the input was checked rather than invented. I therefore call it not-real, but with low confidence, since I could not read action.yml at the pinned commit; if the input truly did not exist there, the whole fix would be a no-op and the severity would be major.
